objective: Test whether the fixed-core low-churn route is constrained by an overly narrow opportunity set without changing its signal, portfolio, costs, or execution.

amendment_from_6_0_scout.reason: Use one strictly causal full-market pipeline for every arm because the legacy monthly Top500 membership lineage cannot prove an incremental-universe-only comparison.

common_base.scope: all-status ordinary CNY A shares on SSE or SZSE; never a current-listed-only roster
common_base.delist_rule: exclude iff delist_date <= signal_date; a future delist date never excludes
common_base.suspended_amount_and_return_policy: zero for the official session with explicit suspension evidence

adv20.sessions: exactly 20 official open sessions ending at signal t inclusive
adv20.missing_bar: zero only with listed-roster and suspension proof; otherwise fail

signal_definition.rank_scope: each candidate universe independently on signal t
signal_definition.volatility_20: sample standard deviation ddof=1 of pct_chg/100 over the same 20 official sessions; proven suspension sessions contribute zero

signal_execution.signal: official close t; universe, score, ADV and ST state are all effective no later than t
signal_execution.entry: t+1 official session open multiplied by contemporaneous adj_factor
signal_execution.holding_end: t+11 official session open multiplied by contemporaneous adj_factor
signal_execution.entry_failure: block, carry or remain cash; never replace a target
signal_execution.execution_liquidity_input: latest valid observation no later than t; never t+1 ADV or volatility

physical_cutoff.phase_rule: signal_date >= phase_start and exact end_date <= phase_end

benchmark.promotion_basis: paired net returns versus daily_adv20_top500_control at the same offset and exact dates
benchmark.common_market_benchmark: diagnostic only; missing endpoints must remain cash, carry, or delist-zero and must never be complete-case deleted

required_tests: t+1 amount cannot change U_t while t amount can
ADV uses exactly 20 official sessions and suspension zero requires proof
ADV threshold includes exactly 100000000 and TopK ties use ticker ascending
listed age 119 is excluded and 120 is included
future delist does not affect t and delist effective on t excludes
ST effective on t excludes while ST effective on t+1 does not affect t
missing next-open, suspension or one-price limit blocks without replacement
selection artifacts containing any outcome after 2024-12-31 are rejected
all universes share identical base eligibility and feature derivation
each offset owns independent retention state and calendar gaps fail
capacity clipping metrics prove why zero violations alone is insufficient
challenger and control exact signal and end dates match for every offset
label or forward-return columns are rejected by the loader
source files are hashed before and after the run
canonical bridge output cannot change gates or selection
